name: the server starts with the whole of its starter's environment again
catches: is what `ovai start` spawns the server with

name: the server keeps the seat it was typed in
catches: starts the server with this instance's home and nothing of the session or seat it was typed in

name: a seat keeps the session its server was typed in
catches: starts a seat with nothing of the session the server was typed in, and its own seat and home

name: a seat's Artifact tools are turned on over the person's own value
catches: turns the Artifact tools on for a seat, and leaves a value the person set as it is

name: a seat is started without the claude.ai account's connectors
catches: leaves the claude.ai account's connectors to every start, a seat's among them, and the person's switch as it is

name: the person's own connector switch is taken off every start
catches: leaves the claude.ai account's connectors to every start, a seat's among them, and the person's switch as it is

name: the directory the starter's shell stood in is handed on
catches: starts the server with this instance's home and nothing of the session or seat it was typed in

name: the starter's session goes by prefix, the machine's sign-in with it
catches: starts the server with this instance's home and nothing of the session or seat it was typed in
